seeds.title: A forge rule with a non-string pattern crashes preflight
seeds.detail: Rules from gh with pattern null, a number, a list or a dict, and an operator starts_with, ends_with, contains or regex, raise TypeError in evaluate/_raw_result. Preflight exits 1 with a traceback and no JSON, so the caller reads it as not ok. Catch TypeError in _raw_result and return None so the sample is unevaluated. Test: preflight.verify-security.test.mjs:150 (A8, todo).

seeds.title: ref_format_error uses --branch and the process cwd, so @{-n} gives a cwd-dependent verdict
seeds.detail: git check-ref-format --branch expands @{-1} against the repository in the cwd. In a repo with branch history, --branch=@{-1} gives unchecked and exit 0. In a plain directory it gives fail. The name refs/heads/@{-1} is invalid. The spec names the --branch form, so this is a seed. Run git from a scratch cwd or add a plain check-ref-format on refs/heads/<name>. Tests: preflight.verify-security.test.mjs:289, :304 (A17, A18, todo).

seeds.title: Dot-segment names reach gh as a path segment
seeds.detail: A working branch .. or . passes through urllib.parse.quote unchanged, so gh api is called with repos/{owner}/{repo}/rules/branches/.. . The request is read-only but targets another endpoint. Skip the gh call for a sample that fails the local ref check. Test: preflight.verify-security.test.mjs:400 (A25, todo).

seeds.title: verify-limits: forge regex with catastrophic backtracking hangs preflight
seeds.detail: A forge pattern ^(a+)+$ against a 41-character working branch does not finish in 8 s. re.search has no time limit. The spec states no limit. Test: preflight.verify-security.test.mjs:413 (A26, todo).

seeds.title: Forge CLI stderr is copied into notes verbatim
seeds.detail: The note rules unknown on github: <stderr> holds the full stderr, up to the whole stream (300000 bytes held in A21). A stderr that holds a token would reach the output and any log. The spec says the note holds <stderr>, so this is a seed. Truncate and redact. Test: preflight.verify-security.test.mjs:421 (A27, todo).

seeds.title: github direct mode gives no rules-unknown note when gh is missing, gitlab does
seeds.detail: With no samples (direct mode) and gh absent, preflight prints ok true and no note. With glab absent it prints one note. The two forges differ. The R-084 acceptance covers samples, so this is a seed. Tests: preflight.verify-security.test.mjs:327 (A20).

seeds.title: testkit: attack-corpus has no ref-name family
seeds.detail: The corpus lacks git ref-name attacks (@{-1}, refs/heads/ prefixes, trailing dot, .lock, bracket and backslash). A15 and A17 define their lists inline.
